changeSet.comment: RDR-243 Phase 2 Step 2.1a: sensitivity=exclude in the 31 vector search functions (10 families x 3 dimensions plus manifest_qualifying_hits). Each takes a trailing p_exclude_sensitive boolean DEFAULT false; when true the statement carries NOT chunk_sensitive(...) inside the search predicate. Old signatures dropped in the same changeset (one function per name), nexus_svc grants re-issued, RETURNS TABLE shapes unchanged. No data effect: function definitions and grants only.
